description: Step 1 of an upload: returns an address to PUT the file to (with exactly the returned headers). Then call confirm_media_upload. Only usable where you can send files, e.g. with curl.

content_type.description: The file's media type. It must match the file you are going to upload.

file_name.description: File name including the extension, for example photo.jpg.

sha256.description: Optional hex digest of the file.

name: create_media_upload
title: Start an upload
